scene.topic_description:
Situation: You return to the same clinic after the first visit because your child still has back pain or the treatment has not helped enough. This scene covers what happens when the doctor reviews progress and decides on the next step after the initial consultation.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: registration details, first description of symptoms, understanding the original instructions, buying medicine at the pharmacy.

ask whether you should continue something — slot: the medicine or treatment
ask whether you need another visit — slot: none
ask whether you need a test — slot: the test
confirm when to come back — slot: the time

asks whether the problem is better, worse, or the same
says you should continue, stop, or change the treatment
explains whether a test or another visit is needed
tells you when to come back if the problem continues

topic.description_target: Talk to the doctor about what is still wrong, what to continue, and when to come back.
topic.description_native: Поговорить с врачом о том, что всё ещё беспокоит, что продолжать и когда прийти снова.

partner_lines.text_target: Did the medicine help at all?
Is it better, worse, or the same?
partner_lines.text_native: Стало лучше, хуже или так же?

partner_lines.text_target: Stop this treatment. Use heat twice a day instead.
partner_lines.text_native: Прекратите это лечение. Вместо этого используйте тепло два раза в день.

partner_lines.text_target: Yes, you need another visit. I want to check the pain again.
partner_lines.text_native: Да, нужен ещё один приём. Я хочу снова проверить боль.

partner_lines.text_target: No test is needed now. We will watch it for a few days.
partner_lines.text_native: Сейчас обследование не нужно. Мы понаблюдаем несколько дней.

partner_lines.text_target: If the pain continues, come back in one week.
partner_lines.text_native: Если боль не пройдёт, приходите через неделю.

TOPIC: Повторный приём

TOPIC_DESCRIPTION: Situation: You return to the same clinic after the first visit because your child still has back pain or the treatment has not helped enough. This scene covers what happens when the doctor reviews progress and decides on the next step after the initial consultation.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: registration details, first description of symptoms, understanding the original instructions, buying medicine at the pharmacy.

About the learner, in their own words: Иду к врачу с ребёнком, болит спина. Первый раз в местной клинике, боюсь не понять назначения

5. ask whether you need another visit — slot: none
6. ask whether you need a test — slot: the test
7. confirm when to come back — slot: the time
must_understand:

Is it better, worse, or the same?
partner_lines.text_native: Стало лучше, хуже или так же?

partner_lines.text_target: Stop this treatment. Use heat twice a day instead.

partner_lines.text_native: Если боль не пройдёт, приходите через неделю.
